name: mobileApps
description: Apps added to Intune with their type, platform, publisher, assignment and version (beta API)

metadata.name: platform
metadata.valueExpression: {{ (() => { const t = (typeof $['@odata.type'] === 'string' ? $['@odata.type'] : '').replace('#microsoft.graph.', '').toLowerCase(); if (!t) { return null; } if (t.startsWith('macos')) { return 'macOS'; } if (t.startsWith('ios') || t.startsWith('managedios')) { return 'iOS'; } if (t.startsWith('android') || t.startsWith('managedandroid')) { return 'Android'; } if (t.startsWith('win') || ['officesuiteapp', 'microsoftstoreforbusinessapp', 'microsoftedgeapp'].includes(t)) { return 'Windows'; } if (t === 'webapp') { return 'Web'; } return 'Other'; })() }}
